title: Uniqueness from separating samples
statement: Let $f:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb F_2$ have algebraic degree at most $\ell$, and let $x_1,\ldots,x_m\in\mathbb F_2^n$ be sample inputs such that evaluation on these inputs is injective on the coefficient assignments indexed by subsets of size at most $\ell$. Any such coefficient assignment that gives the value $f(x_i)$ at every sample input equals the assignment of the algebraic normal form coefficients of $f$ on those subsets.
